<!-- UI_START --><style data-beautiful-inline-css="non-css-regex-v2">
.bf-drawer{
--bf-accent:var(--lumiverse-primary);
--bf-accent-strong:var(--lumiverse-primary-hover);
--bf-accent-soft:var(--lumiverse-primary-020);
--bf-accent-faint:var(--lumiverse-primary-010);
--bf-accent-text:var(--lumiverse-primary-text);
--bf-bg:var(--lumiverse-bg-deep-080);
--bf-bg-top:var(--lumiverse-bg-elevated);
--bf-bg-soft:var(--lumiverse-bg-070);
--bf-bg-inner:var(--lumiverse-bg-040);
--bf-bg-deep:var(--lumiverse-bg-deep);
--bf-bg-darker:var(--lumiverse-bg-darker);
--bf-border:var(--lumiverse-border);
--bf-border-hover:var(--lumiverse-border-hover);
--bf-text:var(--lumiverse-text);
--bf-muted:var(--lumiverse-text-muted);
--bf-shadow:var(--lumiverse-shadow-lg);
box-sizing:border-box;
width:min(92%,620px);
margin:22px auto;
color:var(--bf-text);
font-family:var(--lumiverse-font-family,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,Arial,sans-serif);
}
.bf-drawer,
.bf-drawer *{box-sizing:border-box}
.bf-drawer>summary{
position:relative;
isolation:isolate;
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;
align-items:center;
gap:12px;
min-height:64px;
padding:12px 16px;
overflow:hidden;
cursor:pointer;
list-style:none;
border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 48%,var(--bf-border-hover) 52%);
border-radius:18px;
background:
radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -45%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 12%,transparent),transparent 58%),
radial-gradient(ellipse at 18% 12%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 10%,transparent),transparent 44%),
radial-gradient(ellipse at 82% 9%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 8%,transparent),transparent 42%),
linear-gradient(
180deg,
color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-top) 82%,var(--bf-accent) 18%),
color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-deep) 92%,var(--bf-accent) 8%)
);
box-shadow:
var(--bf-shadow),
0 0 19px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 18%,transparent),
0 0 42px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 7%,transparent),
inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-text) 10%,transparent),
inset 0 -18px 30px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-darker) 72%,transparent);
backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.12);
-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.12);
-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}
.bf-drawer>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.bf-drawer[open]>summary{
border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;
border-bottom-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 20%,var(--bf-border) 80%);
}
.bf-drawer>summary>.bf-kicker,
.bf-drawer>summary>.bf-title,
.bf-drawer>summary>.bf-action{
position:relative;
z-index:2;
}
.bf-drawer>summary::after{
content:"";
position:absolute;
inset:1px;
z-index:-1;
border-radius:inherit;
pointer-events:none;
background:
linear-gradient(112deg,transparent 12%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-text) 5%,transparent) 32%,transparent 51%),
linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-text) 3.5%,transparent),transparent 44%);
}
.bf-kicker{
font:700 8px/1.1 var(--lumiverse-font-mono,'Courier New',ui-monospace,monospace);
letter-spacing:.22em;
text-transform:uppercase;
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 84%,var(--bf-text) 16%);
text-shadow:0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 32%,transparent);
white-space:nowrap;
}
.bf-title{
min-width:0;
font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
font-size:clamp(1.05rem,3.8vw,1.42rem);
font-weight:700;
line-height:1.1;
letter-spacing:.025em;
text-align:center;
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-text) 92%,var(--bf-accent-text) 8%);
text-shadow:
0 0 13px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 21%,transparent),
0 1px 10px var(--bf-bg-darker);
overflow-wrap:anywhere;
}
.bf-action{
display:inline-flex;
align-items:center;
gap:7px;
padding:6px 10px;
border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 34%,var(--bf-border) 66%);
border-radius:999px;
background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-inner) 72%,transparent);
box-shadow:
var(--lumiverse-highlight-inset),
0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 10%,transparent);
font:700 8px/1 var(--lumiverse-font-mono,'Courier New',ui-monospace,monospace);
letter-spacing:.15em;
text-transform:uppercase;
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 72%,var(--bf-text) 28%);
white-space:nowrap;
}
.bf-action::before{
content:"";
width:6px;
height:6px;
border-radius:50%;
background:var(--bf-accent-text);
box-shadow:
0 0 7px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 78%,transparent),
0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 38%,transparent);
animation:bf-dot 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.bf-drawer[open] .bf-action .bf-open-word{display:none}
.bf-drawer:not([open]) .bf-action .bf-close-word{display:none}
.bf-shell{
position:relative;
isolation:isolate;
overflow:hidden;
border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 44%,var(--bf-border) 56%);
border-top:0;
border-radius:0 0 18px 18px;
background:
radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -12%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 6%,transparent),transparent 48%),
radial-gradient(ellipse at 12% 4%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 5%,transparent),transparent 38%),
linear-gradient(
180deg,
color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg) 91%,var(--bf-accent) 9%),
color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-deep) 96%,var(--bf-accent) 4%)
);
box-shadow:
var(--bf-shadow),
0 0 22px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 12%,transparent),
inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-text) 4.5%,transparent);
text-align:left;
}
.bf-shell::after{
content:"";
position:absolute;
inset:0;
z-index:0;
pointer-events:none;
background:linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-text) 2.5%,transparent),transparent 28%,transparent 76%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-darker) 28%,transparent));
}
.bf-content{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:16px}
.bf-meta{
position:relative;
z-index:2;
display:flex;
flex-wrap:wrap;
justify-content:center;
gap:7px;
padding:13px 14px;
border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 17%,var(--bf-border) 83%);
background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-inner) 26%,transparent);
}
.bf-pill{
display:inline-flex;
align-items:center;
gap:6px;
max-width:100%;
padding:6px 10px;
border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 24%,var(--bf-border) 76%);
border-radius:999px;
background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-inner) 72%,var(--bf-accent-faint) 28%);
box-shadow:var(--lumiverse-highlight-inset);
font:700 9px/1.15 var(--lumiverse-font-mono,'Courier New',ui-monospace,monospace);
letter-spacing:.12em;
text-transform:uppercase;
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-muted) 80%,var(--bf-accent-text) 20%);
overflow-wrap:anywhere;
}
.bf-pill b{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 86%,var(--bf-text) 14%)}
.bf-expiry-pill{width:fit-content;max-width:min(100%,560px);justify-content:center;text-align:center}
.bf-tabshell{
position:relative;
z-index:2;
width:100%;
min-width:0;
}
.bf-tabshell>input{
position:absolute!important;
width:1px!important;
height:1px!important;
opacity:0!important;
pointer-events:none!important;
}
.bf-tabs{
position:relative;
z-index:2;
display:flex;
flex-wrap:wrap;
justify-content:center;
gap:7px;
width:100%;
padding:13px 14px 0;
}
.bf-tabs label{
cursor:pointer;
padding:7px 11px;
border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 17%,var(--bf-border) 83%);
border-radius:999px;
background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-inner) 24%,transparent);
font:700 9px/1 var(--lumiverse-font-mono,'Courier New',ui-monospace,monospace);
letter-spacing:.12em;
text-transform:uppercase;
color:var(--bf-muted);
transition:transform .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,background .2s ease,color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;
-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
touch-action:manipulation;
}
.bf-tabs label:hover{
transform:translateY(-1px);
border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 38%,var(--bf-border-hover) 62%);
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 70%,var(--bf-text) 30%);
box-shadow:0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 8%,transparent);
}
.bf-tabshell>input:nth-of-type(1):checked~.bf-tabs label:nth-child(1),
.bf-tabshell>input:nth-of-type(2):checked~.bf-tabs label:nth-child(2),
.bf-tabshell>input:nth-of-type(3):checked~.bf-tabs label:nth-child(3),
.bf-tabshell>input:nth-of-type(4):checked~.bf-tabs label:nth-child(4),
.bf-tabshell>input:nth-of-type(5):checked~.bf-tabs label:nth-child(5),
.bf-tabshell>input:nth-of-type(6):checked~.bf-tabs label:nth-child(6),
.bf-tabshell>input:nth-of-type(7):checked~.bf-tabs label:nth-child(7){
border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 48%,var(--bf-border-hover) 52%);
background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-inner) 58%,var(--bf-accent-soft) 42%);
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 82%,var(--bf-text) 18%);
box-shadow:
0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 12%,transparent),
var(--lumiverse-highlight-inset);
}
.bf-pages{
position:relative;
z-index:1;
width:100%;
min-width:0;
padding:13px 14px 16px;
}
.bf-page{
display:none;
width:100%;
min-width:0;
max-height:380px;
overflow:auto;
padding:14px;
border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 17%,var(--bf-border) 83%);
border-radius:14px;
background:
radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -34%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 3.5%,transparent),transparent 58%),
linear-gradient(
180deg,
color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-soft) 70%,var(--bf-accent-faint) 30%),
color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-inner) 82%,var(--bf-bg-deep) 18%)
);
box-shadow:
var(--lumiverse-highlight-inset),
0 10px 24px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-darker) 46%,transparent);
}
.bf-tabshell>input:nth-of-type(1):checked~.bf-pages>.bf-page:nth-child(1),
.bf-tabshell>input:nth-of-type(2):checked~.bf-pages>.bf-page:nth-child(2),
.bf-tabshell>input:nth-of-type(3):checked~.bf-pages>.bf-page:nth-child(3),
.bf-tabshell>input:nth-of-type(4):checked~.bf-pages>.bf-page:nth-child(4),
.bf-tabshell>input:nth-of-type(5):checked~.bf-pages>.bf-page:nth-child(5),
.bf-tabshell>input:nth-of-type(6):checked~.bf-pages>.bf-page:nth-child(6),
.bf-tabshell>input:nth-of-type(7):checked~.bf-pages>.bf-page:nth-child(7){display:block}
.bf-page::-webkit-scrollbar,
.bf-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar{width:5px}
.bf-page::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
.bf-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{
background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 32%,var(--bf-border) 68%);
border-radius:999px;
}
.bf-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.bf-card{
padding:12px;
border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 15%,var(--bf-border) 85%);
border-radius:12px;
background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-inner) 78%,var(--bf-accent-faint) 22%);
box-shadow:var(--lumiverse-highlight-inset);
}
.bf-label{
margin-bottom:6px;
font:700 9px/1.2 var(--lumiverse-font-mono,'Courier New',ui-monospace,monospace);
letter-spacing:.15em;
text-transform:uppercase;
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 82%,var(--bf-text) 18%);
}
.bf-text{
font-size:13px;
line-height:1.62;
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-text) 90%,var(--bf-muted) 10%);
white-space:pre-wrap;
overflow-wrap:anywhere;
}
.bf-stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.bf-item{
padding:11px;
border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 15%,var(--bf-border) 85%);
border-radius:11px;
background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-inner) 80%,var(--bf-accent-faint) 20%);
}
.bf-item[data-empty=""]{display:none}
.bf-state{
display:inline-flex;
margin-bottom:7px;
padding:4px 8px;
border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 27%,var(--bf-border) 73%);
border-radius:999px;
background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-inner) 70%,var(--bf-accent-soft) 30%);
font:700 8px/1 var(--lumiverse-font-mono,'Courier New',ui-monospace,monospace);
letter-spacing:.12em;
text-transform:uppercase;
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 72%,var(--bf-text) 28%);
}
.bf-state:empty{display:none}
.bf-divider{
height:1px;
margin:13px 0;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 32%,transparent),transparent);
box-shadow:0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 10%,transparent);
}
.bf-prose{
font-size:13px;
line-height:1.72;
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-text) 88%,var(--bf-muted) 12%);
overflow-wrap:anywhere;
}
.bf-prose p{margin:0 0 12px}
.bf-prose p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.bf-prose .p-head,
.bf-prose .p-foot{
font:700 9px/1.55 var(--lumiverse-font-mono,'Courier New',ui-monospace,monospace);
letter-spacing:.11em;
text-transform:uppercase;
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 66%,var(--bf-muted) 34%);
}
.bf-prose .p-head{margin-bottom:12px}
.bf-prose .p-foot{margin-top:12px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 17%,var(--bf-border) 83%)}
.bf-prose font{line-height:1.6}
.bf-chipgrid{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:8px}
.bf-big{
font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
font-size:1.08rem;
line-height:1.45;
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-text) 92%,var(--bf-accent-text) 8%);
text-align:center;
}
.bf-weather-img{
display:block;
width:100%;
max-height:230px;
object-fit:cover;
border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 17%,var(--bf-border) 83%);
filter:saturate(.92) brightness(.78);
}
.bf-refresh-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}
.bf-refresh-row{
display:flex;
justify-content:space-between;
gap:10px;
padding:8px 0;
border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 17%,var(--bf-border) 83%);
font-size:12px;
}
.bf-refresh-row span:first-child{
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 62%,var(--bf-muted) 38%);
font:700 8px var(--lumiverse-font-mono,'Courier New',ui-monospace,monospace);
letter-spacing:.1em;
text-transform:uppercase;
}
.bf-refresh-row span:last-child{
text-align:right;
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-text) 88%,var(--bf-muted) 12%);
overflow-wrap:anywhere;
}
.bf-inline{
display:inline-flex;
align-items:center;
gap:7px;
margin:.08em .12em;
padding:.18em .55em;
border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 35%,var(--bf-border) 65%);
border-radius:999px;
background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-bg-inner) 64%,var(--bf-accent-soft) 36%);
color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 72%,var(--bf-text) 28%);
font:700 .78em var(--lumiverse-font-mono,'Courier New',ui-monospace,monospace);
box-shadow:0 0 10px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 12%,transparent);
}
.bf-hooks-tabs>.bf-pages>.bf-page{min-height:230px}
.bf-hooks-tabs .bf-big{padding-top:2px}
.bf-hooks-tabs .bf-prose{font-size:14px;line-height:1.78}
.bf-item:has(>.bf-text:empty),
.bf-anchor-card:has(>.bf-label:empty){display:none}
.bf-particles{
position:absolute;
inset:0;
z-index:1;
overflow:hidden;
pointer-events:none;
}
.bf-particles i{
--x:50%;--y:50%;--dx:0px;--dy:-24px;--s:3px;--d:8s;--delay:0s;
position:absolute;
left:var(--x);
top:var(--y);
width:var(--s);
height:var(--s);
border-radius:999px;
background:radial-gradient(
circle,
color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 90%,var(--bf-text) 10%) 0 28%,
color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 66%,var(--bf-accent) 34%) 38%,
color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 22%,transparent) 65%,
transparent 72%
);
box-shadow:
0 0 5px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent-text) 72%,transparent),
0 0 12px color-mix(in srgb,var(--bf-accent) 34%,transparent);
opacity:0;
animation:bf-original-particle var(--d) ease-in-out var(--delay) infinite;
}
.bf-particles-summary i:nth-child(1){--x:8%;--y:74%;--dx:8px;--dy:-34px;--s:2px;--d:8.2s;--delay:-1.2s}
.bf-particles-summary i:nth-child(2){--x:17%;--y:24%;--dx:-5px;--dy:-26px;--s:3px;--d:9.6s;--delay:-5s}
.bf-particles-summary i:nth-child(3){--x:31%;--y:82%;--dx:4px;--dy:-42px;--s:2px;--d:10.8s;--delay:-3.8s}
.bf-particles-summary i:nth-child(4){--x:48%;--y:18%;--dx:7px;--dy:-28px;--s:2px;--d:7.9s;--delay:-6.1s}
.bf-particles-summary i:nth-child(5){--x:64%;--y:78%;--dx:-6px;--dy:-37px;--s:3px;--d:9.2s;--delay:-2.6s}
.bf-particles-summary i:nth-child(6){--x:79%;--y:30%;--dx:5px;--dy:-31px;--s:2px;--d:11.2s;--delay:-7.4s}
.bf-particles-summary i:nth-child(7){--x:91%;--y:70%;--dx:-8px;--dy:-30px;--s:3px;--d:8.8s;--delay:-4.7s}
.bf-particles-summary i:nth-child(8){--x:72%;--y:12%;--dx:4px;--dy:-21px;--s:2px;--d:10.4s;--delay:-1.8s}
.bf-particles-shell i:nth-child(1){--x:6%;--y:90%;--dx:9px;--dy:-110px;--s:2px;--d:12.2s;--delay:-2s}
.bf-particles-shell i:nth-child(2){--x:13%;--y:42%;--dx:-8px;--dy:-86px;--s:3px;--d:14.4s;--delay:-9s}
.bf-particles-shell i:nth-child(3){--x:22%;--y:78%;--dx:7px;--dy:-128px;--s:2px;--d:13.8s;--delay:-5.6s}
.bf-particles-shell i:nth-child(4){--x:34%;--y:26%;--dx:-6px;--dy:-72px;--s:2px;--d:11.9s;--delay:-7.8s}
.bf-particles-shell i:nth-child(5){--x:45%;--y:92%;--dx:10px;--dy:-138px;--s:3px;--d:15.2s;--delay:-3.4s}
.bf-particles-shell i:nth-child(6){--x:55%;--y:52%;--dx:-7px;--dy:-102px;--s:2px;--d:12.8s;--delay:-10.2s}
.bf-particles-shell i:nth-child(7){--x:66%;--y:82%;--dx:5px;--dy:-122px;--s:3px;--d:14.8s;--delay:-6.7s}
.bf-particles-shell i:nth-child(8){--x:75%;--y:22%;--dx:-9px;--dy:-68px;--s:2px;--d:13.1s;--delay:-1.4s}
.bf-particles-shell i:nth-child(9){--x:84%;--y:68%;--dx:7px;--dy:-105px;--s:2px;--d:11.7s;--delay:-8.5s}
.bf-particles-shell i:nth-child(10){--x:93%;--y:94%;--dx:-8px;--dy:-144px;--s:3px;--d:15.7s;--delay:-4.9s}
@keyframes bf-original-particle{
0%{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,10px,0) scale(.45)}
18%{opacity:.72}
55%{opacity:.94}
100%{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(var(--dx),var(--dy),0) scale(1.18)}
}
@keyframes bf-dot{
0%,100%{opacity:.55;transform:scale(.85)}
50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.12)}
}
@keyframes bf-drawer-open{
from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-5px) scale(.992)}
to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}
